```{r}
#| label: employment-setup
#| include: false

# The data should already be loaded from the parent document
```

```{r}
#| label: employment-html-display
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr is_html

# FIXED: Group by institution and position to truly consolidate
employment_grouped <- employment %>%
  filter(current == TRUE | as.numeric(substr(start_date, 1, 4)) >= 1997) %>%
  mutate(
    clean_position = case_when(
      is.na(position_title) | position_title == "NA" | position_title == "" ~ "Professor of Finance",
      TRUE ~ position_title
    ),
    period = format_date_range(start_date, end_date),
    full_location = paste0(location_city, " • ", location_state),
    is_current = (is.na(end_date) | end_date == "" | tolower(end_date) == "present")
  ) %>%
  group_by(institution, full_location, clean_position) %>%
  summarise(
    all_periods = list(unique(period)),
    all_additional = list(unique(na.omit(additional_titles[additional_titles != "" & additional_titles != "NA"]))),
    all_courses = list(unique(na.omit(courses_taught[courses_taught != "" & courses_taught != "NA"]))),
    is_current = any(is_current),
    display_order = first(display_order),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  arrange(display_order)

# Output consolidated entries
for (i in 1:nrow(employment_grouped)) {
  entry_class <- if_else(employment_grouped$is_current[i], 
                         "employment-entry current-position", 
                         "employment-entry")
  
  periods_text <- paste(employment_grouped$all_periods[[i]], collapse = ", ")
  
  cat(paste0('
<div class="', entry_class, '">
<div class="position-header">
<span class="position-title">', employment_grouped$clean_position[i], '</span>
<span class="period">', periods_text, '</span>
</div>
<div class="institution-location">', employment_grouped$institution[i], ' • ', employment_grouped$full_location[i], '</div>
'))

  # Add additional titles if any
  if (length(employment_grouped$all_additional[[i]]) > 0) {
    cat('<ul class="additional-titles">\n')
    for (title in employment_grouped$all_additional[[i]]) {
      cat(paste0('<li>', title, '</li>\n'))
    }
    cat('</ul>\n')
  }
  
  # Add courses if any
  if (length(employment_grouped$all_courses[[i]]) > 0) {
    cat(paste0('<div class="courses"><strong>Courses Taught:</strong> ', 
               paste(employment_grouped$all_courses[[i]], collapse = ", "), 
               '</div>\n'))
  }
  
  cat('</div>\n\n')
}
```

```{r}
#| label: employment-pdf-display
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr is_pdf

# FIXED: Group by institution and position for PDF
employment_grouped <- employment %>%
  filter(current == TRUE | as.numeric(substr(start_date, 1, 4)) >= 1997) %>%
  mutate(
    clean_position = case_when(
      is.na(position_title) | position_title == "NA" | position_title == "" ~ "Professor of Finance",
      TRUE ~ position_title
    ),
    period = format_date_range(start_date, end_date, for_pdf = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  group_by(institution, location_city, location_state, clean_position) %>%
  summarise(
    all_periods = list(unique(period)),
    all_additional = list(unique(na.omit(additional_titles[additional_titles != "" & additional_titles != "NA"]))),
    all_courses = list(unique(na.omit(courses_taught[courses_taught != "" & courses_taught != "NA"]))),
    display_order = first(display_order),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  arrange(display_order)

for (i in 1:nrow(employment_grouped)) {
  periods_text <- paste(employment_grouped$all_periods[[i]], collapse = ", ")
  
  cat("\\textbf{", escape_latex(employment_grouped$clean_position[i]), "} (", periods_text, ")\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(escape_latex(employment_grouped$institution[i]), ", ", 
      escape_latex(employment_grouped$location_city[i]), ", ", 
      escape_latex(employment_grouped$location_state[i]), "\n\n", sep = "")
  
  # Combine additional titles and courses into single itemize block
  items_to_list <- c()
  
  if (length(employment_grouped$all_additional[[i]]) > 0) {
    items_to_list <- c(items_to_list, employment_grouped$all_additional[[i]])
  }
  
  if (length(employment_grouped$all_courses[[i]]) > 0) {
    courses_text <- paste("Courses Taught: ", 
                         paste(employment_grouped$all_courses[[i]], collapse = ", "))
    items_to_list <- c(items_to_list, courses_text)
  }
  
  if (length(items_to_list) > 0) {
    cat("\\begin{itemize}\n")
    for (item in items_to_list) {
      cat("\\item ", escape_latex(item), "\n", sep = "")
    }
    cat("\\end{itemize}\n\n")
  }
}
```
